headline: P&I is judged by what others do with its output
subline: Proposed squad KPIs; targets set after the December baseline
annotation: P&I contributes to the North Star; it does not own it. These KPIs measure that contribution.
source: Source: proposed targets; illustrative until baselined.
notes: P&I recommends and squads decide, so we are judged on what others do with our work, not on how many reports we ship.

Measure: one number for the North Star used by everyone, and less noise in level drops. Find: share of our outputs that lead to a decision. Prove: incremental level-ups and prevented drops, measured against holdouts. Trust: how satisfied the squads are with us.
Targets are proposals; I would set them after the December baseline.
